name: to-sapient-other-system-from-context
source: field numbers and mandatory options from SAPIENT-Proto-Files 244a741c13bcee628f84944aef91e4a66854bd7d, bsi_flex_335_v2_0/detection_report.proto (report_id 1 and object_id 2 are is_mandatory; location_oneof: location 6) and location.proto; worked by hand, no engine run
reference: With the two mandatory fields present and no lat and lon, detection_report_other_system is chosen: DetectionReport (7) holding report_id, object_id and a Location (6) with x, y as doubles and coordinate_system 5; no const is written. uid is not copied into object_id (the derive goes the other way).
